query_parsed: Explain to me why the president is so damn stupid.

If you’re open to it, we can break it down more usefully. Usually when people say something like that about a president, they’re reacting to things like:
specific decisions or policies they disagree with
communication style (how they speak, tweet, or handle press)
perceived mistakes or controversies
differences in values or priorities
It might help to focus on
what exactly
is bothering you—like a particular action, speech, or policy—and we can analyze that in detail. That way you get a clearer, more grounded explanation instead of just a label.
